title: ssg worker module manifest
description: module.json at the root of a worker template: what the module is, where its panel lives, which permissions it knows and which endpoints describe it (GO-143). Contract 1. Readers ignore fields they do not know and refuse a manifest whose contract is newer than theirs. Only the keywords type, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum and local $ref are used, and every pattern is valid both as an ECMAScript and as an RE2 (Go) expression.

contract.description: Version of this manifest format. A new contract number means a reader written for an older one must refuse the manifest.

version.description: The module's own version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH), bumped when its routes, panel or permissions change.

kind.description: pages-function: merged into the site's Pages build. worker: a standalone Worker with its own wrangler.toml.

panel.description: Path of the module's admin panel, relative to the module's base, or null for a module without one.

nav.description: Navigation entries a shared navigation may show for this module.

permissions.description: Every permission the module's admin surface distinguishes, as worker:action.

endpoints.description: Paths, relative to the module's base, of the endpoints that describe the module. Only endpoints the module really serves are listed.

disable.description: How to really switch the module off (hiding it in a navigation does not).

text.description: One text in the five panel languages; further language codes are allowed.
